source_package: Claude r9 SS-wall package, 2026-09-30; relocated submission-preparation subset, 2026-10-06
extraction: modes.json keeps every archived candidate and only eigen_index, f, f_im, te, W_max, wall, phase and gap edges. No rounding, interpolation, new solve or physical validation. Unused non-finite xi entries are omitted. geometry.json retains the five named source sections unchanged.
source_gap_label: first two entries of the archived bulk_K_gme3

sampling.rule: s = i/8, i = 0..7 (the eight-phase grid of the main text)

selection: At each phase and wall: strict gap inclusion, TE >= 0.6, W_max >= 0.6; choose largest W_max. Require all eight phases.
frequency_convention: f=a/lambda_0; Legume uses exp(+i omega t), f_im positive for temporal decay.
validation_scope: Independent recomputation of archived scalar selection/averaging only; no independent Maxwell solve, field identity check or validation of radiative Q.
ai_assistance: Source calculations and archive prepared with Claude; extraction, replay implementation and tests prepared with Codex under Nouh Al Busaidi. Human scientific review remains pending.
